title: Casper and the Silence
author: Oscar Nystrom
blurb: Zephyrine Coldharbour, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
